shared_mechanics.new_private_instruction: DiscardThenReturnLand{tapped} sets one mandatory discard for captured item.controller and private DiscardAfter::ReturnLandFromGraveyard{player,tapped}. It reuses owned Resolution discard queues/context; no optional land-choice prompt or global remembered card.
shared_mechanics.actual_discard_predicate: Only moved events whose BEFORE object is a nontoken land owned by the discarding player, whose actual resulting destination is Graveyard, and whose AFTER ObjectRef is still the current exact graveyard incarnation may enter. Actual land entries are staged tapped under the captured player. Exile replacements, unrelated graveyard lands and departed/new incarnations are excluded. The current type of a different card is never substituted for frozen discarded-card facts.
shared_mechanics.graveyard_landfall_reuse: Existing finish_zone_events already includes graveyard sources with InZone conditions in its post-event source snapshots. LandEntersYou checks actual current entered kinds/controller for every entry, including token lands, then common queue logic enforces origin=Graveyard. ReturnSourceToHand(Graveyard) checks exact captured source generation and current zone. MayPayMana1GU/skip1 uses existing ordinary mana-payment continuation and source-independent queued packet. No new index/registration, event variant or history field was needed.
shared_mechanics.ordering_and_ownership: All simultaneous entries collect post-event source views. A Silvan returned simultaneously with a land is now on battlefield and has no graveyard landfall ability; its ordinary ETB still draws/discards. Source departing during an ETB/Miracle pause does not cancel that captured ETB; its new graveyard incarnation may independently trigger from the recovered land.

printed_assertion_map.If actual discarded land, put it FROM YO: Actually drawn Forest goes Hand->GY->BF with generation+2, tapped/owner/controller correct; unrelated GY Forest unchanged. printed_assertion_map.Exact frozen discard-result continuation: Small private shared-contract proof freezes real Hand->GY attempted movement events, then tests normal/stale-new-incarnation/current-exile/replaced-exile worlds before applying follow-on. It isolates impossible-to-intervene continuation boundaries without fabricating a real player priority window. The card scenarios themselves use paid cast/Discard actions.
printed_assertion_map.Miracle suspension: Lorehold grants first drawn Shock Miracle. Private reveal pause retains owned ETB and exact one-draw count; source moved GY, decline resumes mandatory discard of the chosen existing land, automatic tapped entry independently triggers source graveyard landfall; actual1GU return succeeds. Parentdrop/restore repeats to identical final state.
printed_assertion_map.Graveyard-only landfall/current controll: Only GY Silvan triggers; simultaneous BF/Hand/Exile copies excluded. Source BF theft then death resets to owner, a land owned by source owner entering under opponent does not trigger, and opponent-owned land entering under source owner does trigger. Token Forest copies and multiple simultaneous lands yield distinct exact triggers.
printed_assertion_map.Optional1GU actual payment and exact ret: Paid, declined and unpayable branches both seats; invalid zero payment rejected transactionally; mana remains on decline, actual cost spent on pay; tapped mana produced from entering Forest during payment funds actual return. Returned GY card publicly known in hand, distinct from private draw.
printed_assertion_map.Source loss and entry ordering: Old GY trigger may be paid after source exile or new GY incarnation but cannot move that new object. Multiple land triggers retain original ref after first return; later decline is independent. Source+land simultaneous return produces ETB but no graveyard landfall.
printed_assertion_map.Owned/rollback: Representative mandatory-discard/entry-choice/Miracle/payment roots use existing contracts, raw/index independent children, parent disposal and snapshots/restores. Illegal Pass/payment preserve complete snapshot/revision. No all-action simulation bot added.
